animal.title: Animal-Origin Ingredient Detected
animal.short_message: This product contains an ingredient of animal origin, or possible animal origin.
animal.what_detected: Animal-derived ingredient identified. See BOTIA Note below for details.
animal.why_it_matters: Some people avoid animal-origin ingredients for ethical, cultural, religious, or dietary reasons. These ingredients are not always obvious from the product name or appearance.
animal.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA cannot confirm whether this product is vegan, vegetarian, halal, or kosher. It only signals the presence of animal-origin ingredients.
animal.source_note: EU Regulation 1169/2011 requires declaration of animal-origin ingredients · Learn more at botia-safefood.com
